# csv-profiler

> Profile a CSV or XLSX sheet: inferred types, nulls, duplicates, ranges, top values and warnings, as JSON or a script-free self-contained HTML page Python package `trysac-csv-profiler`, import name `csv_profiler`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
